editorial:
Imagine you are a lazy servant who suddenly finds out you are rich. That is exactly what happens to two goofy guys in this wacky comedy. They spent years working for a wealthy old lady, and now that she is gone, they get her money. There is just one catch: they have to take care of her wild, mean pet cat. If they can handle the animal, they keep the cash. The vibe is totally chaotic, and you will spend most of the movie laughing at how these two dim-witted friends struggle to control a tiny creature that basically runs their lives.

You will love the physical comedy and the way the actors play off each other. The pacing stays quick, though some of the jokes feel a bit old-school. It is a great pick if you want something light and silly to turn your brain off to. Since it is an older film, you should try to find a restored version.
endingExplained: After a long struggle with the cat, the two men finally realize that the animal is smarter than they are. The movie wraps up with a funny twist where the cat basically wins the battle of wills. They get to keep the money, but they learn that owning a spoiled pet is more work than their old jobs ever were. It ends on a light note with the trio living in a weird, funny balance.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slapstick humor and funny animals.
